services.name: All Cruises
services.desc: Experience Lake Tahoe’s most spectacular sightseeing adventure on our signature 3.5-hour journey to Emerald Bay. Cruise past stunning lakefront estates, explore hidden coves, and witness the beauty of Vikingsholm Castle and Fannette Island. Delicious, chef-prepared lunch available for purchase. Kick-off your evening with Tahoe’s most scenic happy hour on our relaxing 90-minute afternoon cruise. Enjoy cocktails, wines, and delicious appetizers as you cruise past iconic lakefront landmarks. Watch the mountains glow in the golden afternoon light while our crew shares fascinating stories about Lake Tahoe’s history and hidden gems. blurb: Guests board the Tahoe Gal, a historic paddle wheeler, for scenic cruises on Lake Tahoe including trips to Emerald Bay and along the North and West Shores. Cruises feature views of lakefront estates, hidden coves, Vikingsholm Castle, and Fannette Island. Some cruises offer chef-prepared meals and drinks for purchase.
